forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {這|は}い{出|で}ていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to crawl out, to creep out
definitions.explanation: To emerge by crawling; to come out on hands and knees or by dragging oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}て⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: An insect crawled out of the hole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}た。
examples.english: The baby crawled out of the bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{瓦礫|がれき}→瓦礫：30524_gareki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to crawl out from under the rubble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る⟦{気力|きりょく}→気力：08515_kiryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have the energy to crawl out of the futon.

notes:
{這|は}い{出|で}る is a compound verb: ⟦{這|は}う→這う：00094_hau⟧ (to crawl) + ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る
- No transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
- {這|は}い{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ - is in the process of crawling out
- Telic: describes the action with a clear endpoint (emerging)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る - to crawl out of a hole
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る - to drag oneself out of bed
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る - to finally crawl out

NEAR-SYNONYM:
⟦{這|は}い{出|だ}す→這い出す：17010_haidasu⟧ is also intransitive and also means 'to crawl out'. {這|は}い{出|で}る focuses on having emerged; ⟦{這|は}い{出|だ}す→這い出す：17010_haidasu⟧ leans on the start of the crawling motion.

USAGE:
Beyond literal crawling, {這|は}い{出|で}る is common for escaping a bad situation with great effort: ⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|で}る (to claw one's way out of poverty).

COMPOUND VERB NOTES:
The ～⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ pattern indicates movement outward. Combined with ⟦{這|は}う→這う：00094_hau⟧, it describes emerging by crawling motion.
